notes.title: Major Update – BOT.vinnik Championships Trilogy
notes.content:
[p]Hello comrades![/p][p]
We’ve just deployed a major update across all three BOT.vinnik Soviet Championship titles (Early, Mid-Century, and Late USSR). Our grumpy mentor has been polished up, and the games are running smoother than ever.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]🔊 [b]New BOT.vinnik Reactions[/b]
We imported all the updated reactions straight from our upcoming game, [i]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/i]. The professor now responds to your moves (whether brilliant or disastrous) with even sharper sarcasm and personality.[/p][p]🖥️ [b]Windowed Mode[/b]
No more being trapped in fullscreen! You can now freely toggle between fullscreen and windowed mode with a simple [b]ALT + ENTER[/b].[/p][p]📈 [b]Gameplay Flow Improvements[/b]
Clicking confusion begone! We clarified when clicks are actually needed to proceed.[/p][p]🎨 [b]Minor Visual Refinements[/b]
Subtle tweaks around the chessboard for a cleaner and sharper look.[/p][p]🚀 [b]New Splash Screen[/b]
Now featuring our updated [b]Deep Green Games[/b] studio branding.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We’re thrilled to bring these improvements to the trilogy — and this is just a warm-up.[/p][p]
👉 Don’t forget to add [b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b] to your wishlist! That’s where our sarcastic professor truly shines.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy?snr=1_5_9_"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, comrades!
[/h3]
You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/[/url]

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:
[list]

[*] A reworked scoring system

[*] Structured progression across lessons

[*] Multiple difficulty levels

[*] A growing platform powered by future DLCs

[*] And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet

[/list]
Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42471489/084ddadab27a86a52411acd976da250f6fbedd38.png[/img]
